title: hub: refuse non-suite-1 GroupInfo at room creation
description: Hub::create_room has no explicit cipher_suite check (found by the crate-jmap-50 audit, 2026-10-18; grep of hub/ confirms). OpenMLS may already refuse an unsupported suite while verifying the GroupInfo, but no test proves it. Decision mimid-1wgh.23: suite 1 only. Start with a regression test: create_room with a valid GroupInfo for a group in another suite (e.g. suite 3, from mls-rs or plain OpenMLS, with a PROVENANCE file) must be refused. If it already fails closed, keep the test and add an explicit check with a clear HubError, citing .23. Read the cipher suite from the GroupContext as submit.rs::cipher_suite does.
notes: 2026-10-18: land run exited 101 on an unrelated flaky test (follower_key_material concurrent claims); main unchanged. I closed this bead in error and reopened it. Worktree agent-a6cfe0dde28a624eb is intact; re-land after the claim-race fix.
